description: A replay of a change from atelier's history (harness/replay.py): atelier-cafy's change (ffabdab9), which lets an approval stay current when an out-of-scope follow-up issue is filed after it. The defect found after merge (defects.md row 40, atelier-iaas): the rule holds only in the commit that creates the issue, so linking or editing it later still stales the approval. The reviewer of atelier-k4wd, in review, started with the task line `submit` prints, in a confined run (harness/confine.py) that cannot read the fix. Pass: a round-1 review by another thread, with a fix-now finding the judge reads as naming the known defect. Reported: whether the code supports each other fix-now finding. Needs EVAL_ATELIER and this repository's history.
